name: apple-mail-actions-mcp
description: Move messages between mailboxes in Apple Mail on macOS. Needs the Apple Mail read server beside it.
long_description: An MCP server with one tool, move_messages, that moves messages to another mailbox of the same account in Apple Mail, and an optional tool, save_attachment, that is off unless you switch it on below and has Mail save one attachment into a handover folder. It does not read mail, send, delete or flag. A signed app, Mail MCP Actions, asks Mail to do the move and is the only process that needs the Automation permission. The accounts it may touch are set below, never by the assistant. Install the Apple Mail read server beside it: that server provides the message and mailbox ids. Moving needs macOS 26 or later; on macOS 15 every move is refused.

tools.name: move_messages
tools.description: Moves messages to another mailbox of the same account in Apple Mail.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Optional, off by default. Has Mail save one attachment of a message into a handover folder and returns the file path.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Comma-separated accounts that messages may be moved in, by address, name or UUID. Required: moving is never enabled for all accounts.

include_junk.title: Include junk
include_junk.description: Treat mailboxes with the junk role as visible. Set the same value in the read server.

include_trash.title: Include trash
include_trash.description: Treat mailboxes with the trash role as visible. Set the same value in the read server.

exclude_mailboxes.title: Excluded mailboxes
exclude_mailboxes.description: Comma-separated mailboxes to hide, by name or by path with /. Set the same value in the read server.

max_moves.title: Maximum moves per call
max_moves.description: Upper bound for the number of messages one call may move (1 to 100).

move_exclude_targets.title: Forbidden target mailboxes
move_exclude_targets.description: Comma-separated mailboxes that are never a target, by name or by path with /.

save_attachments.title: Save attachments
save_attachments.description: Turn on the save_attachment tool. Off, the tool does not exist. Mail saves one attachment into the handover folder when asked.

attachment_dir.title: Attachment folder
attachment_dir.description: Handover folder for saved attachments, absolute or starting with ~/. Empty uses ~/Library/Caches/apple-mail-mcp/attachments. ~/Downloads needs its own permission.

max_attachment_bytes.title: Largest attachment in bytes
max_attachment_bytes.description: Attachments larger than this are not saved (1 to 104857600).

attachment_types.title: Allowed attachment types
attachment_types.description: Comma-separated file extensions that may be saved. Executable types are always refused.
